chain.title: Professor Khaan's Field Notes
chain.desc: The Animal Dictionary is crafted from a book and green dye and catalogues every creature in the mod.

chain.title: Nightmare Fuel of the Nether
chain.desc: A bloated Crimson Mosquito drops both a Mosquito Proboscis and a Blood Sac.

chain.title: Spray 'n Pray
chain.desc: Crafted from a Blood Sac, a Mosquito Proboscis and nether brick, this is the mod's first ranged sidearm.

chain.title: Destroyer of Chads
chain.desc: The Warped Mosco is a Crimson Mosquito fed a Mungus and drops a Hemolymph Sac and Warped Muscle.

chain.title: Blast From the Future
chain.desc: The Hemolymph Blaster is the Blood Sprayer's direct upgrade and needs Hemolymph Sac, Warped Muscle and Mimicream.

chain.title: Eye of the Storm
chain.desc: Gusters spawn during desert storms and drop a Guster Eye when the sand column collapses.

chain.title: Weather On Demand
chain.desc: A Guster Eye, cut sandstone and redstone build a block that generates your own miniature sand cyclones.

chain.title: Fetch Me Their Souls
chain.desc: A Soul Vulture bloated on stolen souls drops a Soul Heart, which lures Spectres in the End.

chain.title: Keep Rollin'
chain.desc: Rocky Rollers charge through the dripstone caves and drop a Rocky Shell.

chain.title: You're Too Slow
chain.desc: Nine Rocky Shells make a chestplate that lets you curl into a rolling ball while sprinting.

chain.title: Sever the Head
chain.desc: Only the head segment of a Cave Centipede drops Centipede Legs.

chain.title: Ceilings Are Floors Now
chain.desc: Cave Centipede Leggings are built from Centipede Legs and grant wall climbing.

chain.title: We Just Want Our Hat Back
chain.desc: Skelewags haunt sunken ships and drop Fish Bones, a Novelty Hat and their sword-shaped skull.

chain.title: Teeth Turned Outward
chain.desc: A Serrated Shark Tooth, a Shark Tooth, prismarine bricks and a Heart of the Sea make a shield that bites back.

chain.title: Who Undermines the Underminer
chain.desc: Underminers tunnel toward hidden ore; break the block one is mining and it turns on you.

chain.title: Ghost, Ghost, Toast
chain.desc: The Ghostly Pickaxe is taken directly from a slain Underminer rather than crafted.

chain.title: Stilts in the Basalt
chain.desc: Straddlers stalk the Basalt Deltas on long legs and drop Straddlite.

chain.title: Surf Wax America
chain.desc: Straddlite plus netherite yields a board that lets you ride the Nether's lava seas.

chain.title: Ender Distancing
chain.desc: Enderiophages drift through the End Midlands, spread Ender Flu, and drop a Capsid.

chain.title: Destroy the Child
chain.desc: Putting a Crimson Mosquito Larva inside a Capsid produces the Mysterious Worm.

chain.title: Should've Gone For the Head
chain.desc: Throwing the Mysterious Worm into the End's void summons the Void Worm, which splits when struck on the body.

chain.title: Break On Through
chain.desc: A Void Worm Eye, a Void Worm Mandible and netherite forge a tool that cuts a portal home from anywhere.

chain.title: Farland Security
chain.desc: The Farseer guards the world border and drops a Farseer Arm.

chain.title: Nonequivalent Exchange
chain.desc: A Farseer Arm, obsidian and a nether star build a table that converts materials into almost anything.

notes: Verified against alexsmobs-1.22.9.jar: 290 ids appear both as assets/alexsmobs/models/item/*.json and as item./block. lang keys; 140 entity.alexsmobs.* lang keys. Descriptions are drawn from the 106 advancement JSONs plus their advancements.alexsmobs.*.desc strings and from data/alexsmobs/loot_tables/entities/*.json. The spine deliberately runs Animal Dictionary -> Crimson Mosquito line (blood_sprayer -> hemolymph_blaster) -> overworld/cave gear -> Nether (straddler/straddleboard) -> End (enderiophage -> mysterious_worm -> void_worm -> dimensional_carver) -> Farseer/transmutation_table, matching the mod's own advancement dependency order. IDS DROPPED: alexsmobs:blood_gun_empty, alexsmobs:blood_sprayer_empty, alexsmobs:hemolymph_blaster_empty, alexsmobs:shield_of_the_deep_blocking, alexsmobs:skelewag_sword_blocking, alexsmobs:stink_ray_empty_inventory, alexsmobs:stink_ray_hand_base, alexsmobs:tarantula_hawk_elytra_broken, alexsmobs:tendon_whip_active, alexsmobs:sombrero_upside_down, alexsmobs:pupfish_locator_in_chunk - all are render-state models with no lang key. alexsmobs:mimicube and alexsmobs:mungus were considered for the mosquito line but cut to stay inside 24 steps; both are valid entities in this jar. alexsmobs:underminer has no entity loot table - the Ghostly Pickaxe drop is code-driven and is documented by advancements.alexsmobs.ghostly_pickaxe.desc instead.
